status: retrospective extension; datasets and earlier results already known
identity: Applied computational method for distinguishing supported commodity-flow conclusions from unresolved allocations; no first-in-literature theorem claim.
questions: Does the production solver retain its numerical agreement and timing advantage against an independently implemented record-stage tree dynamic program that does not enumerate losses?
At fixed historical fitting and calibration periods, how often do reported intervals resolve a declared destination-share threshold correctly?
How do total-variation intervals compare with mass-balanced maximum-absolute-error intervals using identical current information and calibration cases?
Can a constructed reporting-design example link prospective resilience to conditional bounds while preserving its explicitly illustrative status?
benchmark: All 21 archived synthetic cases; fresh construction and all target/budget outputs; 7 paired repetitions after warm-up with deterministic alternating order; measured medians and full ranges; no power/thermal control; no universal fastest-solver claim.
decision: UK 2010 raw data; Jan-May fitting, Jun-Aug calibration, Sep-Dec evaluation; fixed historical nonlocal anchor; primary calibration 90%; thresholds 5,10,25,50 percent of current movement-group total; all thresholds retained. Include zero-valued eligible compartments and show positive-only sensitivity. Thresholds illustrative, not policy recommendations.
comparators: Information-only bounds; unchanged archived TEM-FLOW total-variation bounds; independently calibrated maximum-absolute-share-error box intersected with simplex; same current group total and measured anchor for all methods.
outcomes: Nonzero coverage, simultaneous coordinate coverage, normalized interval width, resolved fraction, incorrect classifications among resolved, all thresholds. No significance testing or external population inference.
stop_rule: One specified benchmark and decision analysis; report all outcomes, including absent advantages. Additional runs only for identified implementation errors. No new fitting choices selected using September-December performance.
boundaries: Administrative count analysis, not weighed mass, African field validation, or externally validated operational thresholds. No altered production mathematics. Private chemistry excluded.
